name: [2026.1] Engine Transition Glide
description: Diesel/electric swaps no longer feel like a brake: the incoming engine picks up the thrust the outgoing engine was making (never more than its own setting allows) and the game's own ramp takes over within a few seconds. Damage, empty battery, no fuel, diesels submerged, stop orders, charging and alarm/crash dive stay stock. By Landomatic.
author: Landomatic
